title.en: The Last Quarter of the Moon

review.en: An old Evenki woman, near the end of her people's reindeer-herding life in the forests of the far northeast, tells the story of her clan across a century. Chi Zijian writes with deep respect for their shamanism and their land, and the nature writing is lovely. The narrative can feel elegiac by programme, but it gives a rare voice to a vanishing world. Mao Dun Prize, 2008.
review.zh: 大兴安岭的森林里，鄂温克族最后一位女酋长讲述她的部族近百年的故事：驯鹿、萨满、迁徙。迟子建对他们的信仰和土地怀着深深的敬意，自然描写很美。挽歌的调子有时过于用力，但它为一个正在消失的世界留下了少见的声音。2008 年获茅盾文学奖。
